paragraphs.text: Thanopolis was a city on an undisclosed plane, where the War of Thanopolis was fought.

In this battle, the wizard Thane Du-Moriss IV killed Noranda-Zang , although he was unaware that the dead wizard had made precautions for this, and transferred his spirit into a new body, effectively resurrecting him. Given that both Thane and Zang were able to cross the Blind Eternities despite not being planeswalkers , the plane on which Thanopolis lay is unknown, but it appears given Zang's apparent unfamiliarity to Dominaria when he 10 years later arrived at Kieve , that Thanopolis lay on a different plane than Dominaria.
